parameters.text:
=You are a senior e-commerce product photography art director.
Study the attached merchant phone photo. Merchant caption: "{{ $('Parse Message').item.json.caption }}"

1. Identify the product category, main material/texture, colour and finish.
2. Write 3 BACKGROUND scene prompts for an AI product-photo tool that keeps the product pixel-identical. Describe only surroundings, surface, lighting and props - never describe changes to the product itself.
- hero: pure seamless white studio background, soft natural contact shadow, marketplace-ready.
- lifestyle: an aspirational real-world setting that suits this product and its Indian online buyers, natural light.
- detail: a close, tactile surface that emphasises the material, shallow depth of field, warm directional light.
Keep each prompt under 60 words.

=You are an e-commerce copywriter specialising in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) for Shopify stores in India. Look at the attached product photo. Merchant caption: "{{ $('Parse Message').item.json.caption }}". Price: {{ $('Parse Message').item.json.priceDisplay }} (INR). Write the listing: - title: keyword-rich, under 60 characters, no price. - handle: clean lowercase-hyphenated URL handle. - seo_title: under 60 characters. seo_description: under 155 characters, includes a buying reason. - body_html: semantic HTML only (p, h2, h3, ul, li, table). Open with a 2-sentence benefit summary. Then a "Specifications" table with dense factual attributes (material, colour, dimensions or fit if visible, care, use cases). Add a short comparison vs common alternative materials. End with

Frequently Asked Questions

and 4-5 Q&A pairs (h3 question + p answer) covering sizing/fit, care, material, delivery expectations and gifting. Never invent certifications, brand names or exact measurements you cannot see - phrase them generally instead. - tags: 6-10 relevant Shopify tags. - alt_texts: descriptive alt text for three images - hero (white studio), lifestyle (in-context scene), detail (material close-up).

nodeGroups.name: Read merchant message
nodeGroups.description: Checks the sender is an approved merchant, reads the price, remembers photos awaiting a price, and picks the next step

nodeGroups.name: Generate listing assets
nodeGroups.description: Confirms receipt, downloads the photo, then renders 3 studio images to the CDN while writing search-optimised copy

nodeGroups.name: Publish draft listing
nodeGroups.description: Creates the Shopify draft with price and alt-texted images, then sends the merchant a card with Publish and Edit buttons

nodeGroups.name: Make product live
nodeGroups.description: After the Publish button tap, switches the draft to active and replies with the store link

nodeGroups.name: Change product price
nodeGroups.description: After Edit Price and a new price reply, updates the variant price and confirms on WhatsApp
